fact: A survey of 420 health workers carried out from November 2019 to May 2020 in public facilities using the Integrated Patient Management System, among them Princess Marina and Nyangabgwe referral hospitals, district hospitals and Gumare, Kasane and Letlhakeng primary hospitals, found 69.1% of referral-hospital and 68.5% of general-hospital respondents using IPMS more than once a day.
title: Adoption and Utilization of Integrated Patient Management System in Botswana Public Health Facilities
publisher: E-Journal of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (Noyam Publishers)
